Raters judge whether the generated text accurately conveys the meaning (accuracy) and rate its naturalness on a 1‑5 scale (fluency).

Human raters are shown the gold text and the predicted text and are instructed to mark the generated text as accurate if it correctly conveys the meaning of the gold text.
